newsitem.title: CANADA: Thomson Corp to issue C$300 mln pfd shrs.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Corp to issue C$300 mln pfd shrs.

text.p: Thomson Corp said it will issue C$300 million worth of fixed/floating rate cumulative redeemable preference shares, series V.

The 12 million series V shares will be priced at C$25 a share and will pay an annual fixed cumulative preferred cash dividend of $1.25 per share five percent until January 1, 2002 on the first day of January, April, July and October. The initial dividend will be payable on April 1, 1997.
From January 1, 2002 , dividends will be payable monthly on a floating and adjustable basis, with the first monthly dividend payable February 12, 2002.

The Series V Preference Shares are not redeemable prior to January 2, 2002 and at Thomson's option, the Series V Preference Shares will be redeemable on January 2, 2002 at C$25 a share and thereafter at C$25.50 a share.

The net proceeds from the sale of the Series V Preference Shares to the public will be used to repay indebtedness incurred on the issuance of commercial paper and for general corporate purposes, Thomson said.

The issue will be underwritten by RBC Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc, Scotia McLeod Inc, TD Securities Inc, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc, First Marathon Securities Limited, Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc, and Trilon Securities Corporation.
